chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The endurer does not miss success although it may take a long time.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between patience and success in Shia Islamic teachings?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) links the virtue of sabr (patience) directly to zafer (victory), reflecting the Shia theological view that endurance is an active spiritual struggle rather than passive waiting. This teaching underscores that divine reward is inevitable for the steadfast, reinforcing the concept that time is merely a test of resolve. It serves as a practical reminder for believers to maintain constancy in worship and moral conduct despite delayed outcomes.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 153. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The endurer does not miss success although it may take a long time.
